narr: An area of low pressure supported widespread showers and thunderstorms on July 30th and 31st. Slow storm motions allowed heavy rain to fall over the same area, with high rainfall rates over 2 inches per hour. The most significant flooding occurred over Grafton County where saturated ground conditions and steep terrain supported flash flooding in Piermont.
ev: Heavy rainfall caused significant washouts on NH-25C in Warren.
The North Branch of Oliverian Brook caused a washout on NH 25 at Lime Kiln Road in Benton.

Oliverian Brook rose rapidly on the evening of the 31st following heavy rainfall. Floodwaters surrounded a home on Gheradi Road near Mt. Moosilauke Highway in Haverhill, requiring at least one swift water rescue.
Gale Chandler Road in Landaff was down to a one lane due to a washout.
In Landaff, Mill Brook came out of banks and flooded Brook Lane which caused a partial road washout.
Significant flooding along the Oliverian Brook caused a washout on NH-25 at Jeffers Hill Road in Piermont.
